QuestionStmt.S:
Match column I (process) with column II (application).

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|}\hline
\textbf{Column I} & \textbf{Column II} \\ \hline
i.\ Dialysis & a.\ Cleansing\ action\ of\ soap \\
ii.\ Peptization & b.\ Coagulation \\
iii.\ Emulsification & c.\ Colloidal\ solution\ preparation \\
iv.\ Electrophoresis & d.\ Purification\ of\ colloidal\ solution \\ \hline
\end{array}$$

Option1Stmt.S: i - d, ii - a, iii - c, iv - b

Option2Stmt.S: i - d, ii - c, iii - a, iv - b

Option3Stmt.S: i - c, ii - b, iii - d, iv - a

Option4Stmt.S: i - b, ii - c, iii - a, iv - d

Solution.S: Dialysis → purification of colloidal solution (d). Peptization → preparation of colloidal solution (c). Emulsification → cleansing action of soap (a). Electrophoresis → used in coagulation (b). Thus the correct matching is i-d, ii-c, iii-a, iv-b, which corresponds to option B.
